title: Oven-Roasted Irish Lamb Stew
description: A rich, low-FODMAP stew featuring tender lamb and a hint of Marsala wine, slow-cooked to perfection in the oven.

ingredients.name: 1 kg lamb shoulder, cut into 3 cm pieces

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook until the vegetables are slightly tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the Marsala wine, lamb stock, thyme, salt and pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a simmer, then cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
